Task: Write down what we're building and why, before writing any code
DoD: The spec, plan, and task documents all exist and were approved.

Task: Get the codebase, tools, and data shapes ready to build on
DoD: The project installs cleanly and the core data shapes are defined and tested.

Task: Turn a template plus real data into an actual ready-to-send prompt
DoD: Every prompt and test case combination fills in correctly, with a clear error if something's missing.

Task: Send prompts to Groq, Gemini, and OpenRouter at the same time, safely
DoD: Calls run in parallel, capture real timing and token data, and one failure never crashes the batch.

Task: Have a second AI score each answer and explain why
DoD: Every answer gets a real 1-5 score with a reason, even if the AI's response is malformed.

Task: Turn all the scores into one ranked leaderboard with a clear winner
DoD: The tool picks one winner and explains in plain English why the others scored lower.

Task: Wire everything into one real command you can type in a terminal
DoD: Typing 'prompteval run <file>' actually runs the whole tool and saves a report.

Task: Run the finished tool for real and write the README
DoD: A real run works with no crashes, and the README alone is enough to get started.

Task: Type one prompt, get a score and a rewritten, better version
